text: Which e POS terminal does the processing center expect each debit to come through?
prefix: Which e POS terminal does the processing center expect each debit to come through?

text: It only accepts debits from e POS terminals it already knows: a MID and a TID it issued.
prefix: It only accepts debits from e POS terminals it already knows: a MID and a TID it issued.

text: So the e POS module keeps a registry: for each website and card scheme, one merchant ID and one terminal ID.
prefix: So the e POS module keeps a registry: for each website and card scheme, one merchant ID and one terminal ID.

text: Uzcard and Humo payments can use different e POS terminals for the very same website.
prefix: Uzcard and Humo payments can use different e POS terminals for the very same website.

text: An e POS terminal is registered only for a website that exists and accepts that card, and the check fails closed.
prefix: An e POS terminal is registered only for a website that exists and accepts that card, and the check fails closed.

text: The database allows one live e POS terminal per website and card, and a merchant and terminal ID pair is never issued twice.
prefix: The database allows one live e POS terminal per website and card, and a merchant and terminal ID pair is never issued twice.

text: A Uzcard e POS terminal is also registered at Uzcard's SV-Gate, terminal add and then terminal check, and it is kept only if Uzcard accepts it, so a retry is always safe.
prefix: A Uzcard e POS terminal is also registered at Uzcard's SV-Gate, terminal add and then terminal check, and it is kept only if Uzcard accepts it, so a retry is always safe.

text: Suspend and resume stay in our registry, because SV-Gate has no method to pause a terminal, and a revoked one never comes back.
prefix: Suspend and resume stay in our registry, because SV-Gate has no method to pause a terminal, and a revoked one never comes back.

text: Revoking a Uzcard e POS terminal removes it from SV-Gate first, and if Uzcard refuses or stays silent, nothing changes.
prefix: Revoking a Uzcard e POS terminal removes it from SV-Gate first, and if Uzcard refuses or stays silent, nothing changes.

text: Admins check any Uzcard e POS terminal at SV-Gate, terminal check and terminal get side by side, and register one that SV-Gate never got.
prefix: Admins check any Uzcard e POS terminal at SV-Gate, terminal check and terminal get side by side, and register one that SV-Gate never got.

text: Every change is written to an audit log: who, what, and why.
prefix: Every change is written to an audit log: who, what, and why.

text: Before every debit, the payment module asks for the live e POS terminal, and no e POS terminal means no debit.
prefix: Before every debit, the payment module asks for the live e POS terminal, and no e POS terminal means no debit.

text: The e POS module also lists a scheme's active and suspended terminals, so the card module can reconcile each one with Humo.
prefix: The e POS module also lists a scheme's active and suspended terminals, so the card module can reconcile each one with Humo.

text: Admins find any e POS terminal by website, card scheme, or status, or by part of its merchant or terminal ID, and open it to see its history and act on it.
prefix: Admins find any e POS terminal by website, card scheme, or status, or by part of its merchant or terminal ID, and open it to see its history and act on it.

text: Next, the card schemes themselves: talking to Uzcard and Humo.
prefix: Next, the card schemes themselves: talking to Uzcard and Humo.
